title: Polynomial-time output of a prescribed unary length
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, all natural numbers $d,c$, and every finite Turing machine $V$ over the binary alphabet with natural numbers $C_V,c_V$, the function sending an input $x$ to the string of $3R(|x|)^2+3R(|x|)$ ones is polynomial-time computable, where $R(n)=W(n)(n+1)^{c+1}$ and $W(n)=4dW_N+W_N+12k_Nd+3k_N+2|Q_N|+8$, with $W_N=h_N+3k_N+1$ and $h_N$ the number of possible head summaries of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine
$V$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
caveat: The statement uses the machine parameters and head-summary count implicit in the supplied definitions; the informal descriptions of those quantities are absent.
